'''Mals Tonith''' was the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[High officer|High Officer]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] during the 9th century of the [[Great Peace of the Republic]] period.<ref name="Mals Tonith timeline">According to [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], Mals Tonith was High Officer immediately prior to the birth of Hego Damask&mdash;at least 10 years prior ([...] ''"success in supervising the mining operations came in short order"'' [...] ''the arrival&mdash;ten years after his own&mdash;of a lower-caste Muun female'' [...]), but not many more ("[...] ''in due course giving birth to a son they named Hego'' [...]). Hego Damask himself told Palpatine, in 65 BBY, that he would be "well over one hundred" in human years, which is contradicted in ''[[The Tenebrous Way]]'', where it is implied that Plagueis is at the very least two decades younger than that ([[Star Wars Insider 130|''Star Wars Insider'' 130]]). In any case, Mals Tonith must have been High Officer at some point between 200 and 100 BBY, during the 9th century after the Ruusan Reformations.</ref> As a personal favor to Tonith, [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] member [[Caar Damask]] accepted administratorship of the planet [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]].<ref name="Darth P" />
